    Every row class is a word trace (Lemmas A.2 and A.4) #

    lem:twisted-trace-surjection (surjectivity) and lem:arm-trace-reduction (first part), periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "Lift a row path from τ(x, j). … The map from twisted paths to row classes is well defined and surjective." and "If a path from v to θ v meets the centre o, cut it there. Twisted rotation gives a path from o to θ o = o, and Lemma A.3 expresses it in the x_i. A path avoiding o stays on one arm. That arm is fixed pointwise by θ … the process ends in zero."

    Lemma A.2, surjectivity: every row class of degree m + 1 = 2 + s is a combination of word traces at the centre.
